newsitem.title: USA: Workforce Systems names Hausman president.
newsitem.headline: Workforce Systems names Hausman president.

text.p: Workforce Systems Corp said Tuesday that with the completion of the acquisitions of privately-held Federal Supply Inc and Federal Fabrication Inc, it has named Robert Hausman as president of Workforce.
Hausman is president of both Federal Supply and Federal Fabrication. Ella Chesnutt, formerly president and chairman of the company, will remain as chairman of the company.
Workforce acquired the companies for 110,000 restricted shares of its common stock. The companies will operate as wholly-owned units of Workforce Systems.
Federal Supply and Federal Fabrication together serve as a fabricator and distributor of a wide range of custom-designed components for fire sprinkler systems.
